svg.aria-label: Echo Persona 1.0.0-beta: a glowing blue, purple and indigo brain with Echo's new cognitive functions pointing to brain regions
svg.text: Decides how to handle each thing you say
Remembers what it was doing, even after a restart
Picks up on feelings, not just words
Keeps track of what you’re talking about
Learns the way you want it to talk
Drops background work the moment you speak
Asks about your photos, shows them when asked
Checks over the weeks that it isn’t slipping
Starts answering in a quarter of a second
A new brain: Unified Cognitive Architecture 2.0
Regions are a metaphor for Echo's software modules, not a model of a real brain.
